scope: eight scalar-class points; no E/L transfer and no full tensor rerun

resource_audit.reason_claimed_shortcut_is_not_cheap: The direct_sign timer includes construction of JR, JC and Jd. Stage C reuses Jd, so omitting the direct sign branch-and-bound does not omit the expensive tensor construction required by the current vertical-certificate implementation.

provenance_limits: The pilot output stores no source hashes or Git revision.

The points file and all evaluated outputs first appear in one commit; the script writes the points file before its evaluation loop, but Git history alone cannot establish prospective freezing before results were known.

Exact endpoint reconstruction here uses the shared n3_certificate kernel implementation; it is independent of the affine moment/tensor route, not an independent implementation of the ecological transition model.

P1's full Delta tensor and both sign checks were recomputed once for resource decomposition when --time-tensor was used. P2-P8 tensors were not repeated; their saved leaf counts remain bound only by the committed source, JSON and log.

tensor_recomputation.P1: full JR, JC, Jd, direct sign and vertical sign recomputed
tensor_recomputation.P2-P8: saved tensor leaf summaries inspected, not recomputed
